title: Postcard-style onboarding snapshots & inline tips for Optimize Toolkit (batching, caching, quant UI)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact set of postcard-style preview cards and full-width snapshot screens for the first-run Optimize Toolkit. These assets will communicate batching and caching recommendations, show a simplified quantization selector, and include inline tooltips for key knobs. Output: high-fidelity screenshots for Console quickstart, responsive export sets for docs, Figma files with component variants, and a handoff spec (CSS tokens, spacing, and copy).
tasks: Lock art direction for postcard cards (3 visual moods: neutral, performance-first, cost-first)
Create 3 card variants for batching recommendations: conservative, balanced, aggressive
Design caching preview with heatmap overlay to indicate hit-rate expectations
Design quantization selector UI with 3 states and microcopy for trade-offs
Write concise tooltip copy for each control (20-50 chars each)
Produce full-width snapshot screen used in docs hero and console onboarding
Export 2x/3x PNG and WebP screenshot sets for desktop and mobile
Prepare Figma handoff file with component tokens and naming conventions
Run internal design review and incorporate eng feedback (performance, accessibility)
Handoff to frontend with GitHub issue linking assets and spec
acceptance_criteria: Three postcard card variants completed and reviewed in Figma
Quantization selector designs include states: Recommended, Aggressive, Legacy with explicit microcopy
Caching preview includes heatmap overlay and one simulated example explaining cache hit improvements
All screenshots exported at required resolutions and uploaded to Drive with naming convention
Design tokens and spacing documented in handoff spec and PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/ (placeholder)
Accessibility checks: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary CTA, tooltips keyboard-focusable
PM and Eng approvals recorded in comments and design review checklist
